title: Neymar to Queen Elizabeth II: how?
description: Three real photos link Neymar to Queen Elizabeth II, by way of a Brazilian president and a future king.
hook: How's Neymar linked to Queen Elizabeth II?

links.line: In 2019, Neymar met Brazil's president, Jair Bolsonaro, at the Copa América final.

image.file: File:2019 Reunião Bilateral com o Príncipe Charles - 48947648318.jpg

links.line: That October, Bolsonaro met Prince Charles in Tokyo for a new emperor's enthronement.

image.file: File:Queen Elizabeth II Platinum Jubilee 2022 - Platinum Pageant (52123563502).jpg

links.line: And in 2022, Charles shared the Jubilee balcony with his mother, the Queen.
